problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}10 & 5 & -5 \\ -1 & 3 & -4 \\ 8 & 8 & 0\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}0 & 5 & 0 \\ -7 & 3 & -1 \\ -8 & 8 & 8\end{aligned}]
$$

By applying elementary column operations of the form ${C}_{i}:={C}_{i}+k{C}_{2},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the elementary column operations?
worked_solution:
To transform $A$ into $B,$ we need to make entries to the left and to the right of ${a}_{12}=5$ equal to $0.$

To do this, we can apply the following elementary column operations:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}10 & 5 & -5 \\ -1 & 3 & -4 \\ 8 & 8 & 0\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{1}:={C}_{1}-2{C}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 5 & -5 \\ -7 & 3 & -4 \\ -8 & 8 & 0\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{3}:={C}_{3}+{C}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 5 & 0 \\ -7 & 3 & -1 \\ -8 & 8 & 8\end{aligned}] \\  & =B\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the elementary column operations are

$\,$ ${C}_{1}:={C}_{1}-2{C}_{2}\,$ and $\,{C}_{3}:={C}_{3}+{C}_{2}.$
